Subject: Next steps + initial MAP draft (timeline options)

Michael / Sonia —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and the proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to get us to a pilot decision:

High-level recap
- Use case: document summarization + medical note generation to accelerate case review across claims QA.
- Primary success metric: 30% reduction in triage time while maintaining >95% clinical precision on redaction rules.
- Key constraints: PHI handling (VPC deployment), audit log retention (2 years), and integration with your S3 buckets.

Attached is a first-pass MAP (BrightHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx) with 3 timeline options. I tried to keep milestones practical while surfacing dependencies. The short version:
- Option A (aggressive): 6–8 weeks to pilot start — requires security checklist + SOC2 evidence by week 2.
- Option B (balanced): 10–12 weeks — allows procurement + legal review time.
- Option C (conservative): 14–18 weeks — for org-level approvals and on-prem validation.

Immediate asks
1) Confirm the core stakeholders we should include on the MAP (we've penciled: Michael Tan, Sonia Patel, Procurement inbox). Please add any additional names and the role you expect them to own (technical contact, procurement lead, legal reviewer).
2) Which timeline option looks realistic for BrightHealth? If you prefer, pick A/B/C or give a target close date.
3) Any hard blockers we didn't surface in the call? (e.g., policy approvals, procurement windows, security scan schedules)

Next steps from Redwood
- I’ll circulate an editable MAP (xlsx) with owners and target dates populated based on your feedback.
- Aditya will prepare a short SOW summary and cost guidance for the pilot (attached SOW_summary.pdf).

Attachments: 
- BrightHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP, milestones/responsibilities)
- SOW_summary.pdf (pilot scope + estimated run-rate)

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
